reason: Adds a separate smart_subagent tool for explicit per-call model and reasoning-effort selection, including continuable background children and follow-ups; its primary purpose is agent orchestration.

summaries.zh: 为智能体调用新增可按请求选择模型与推理强度的 smart_subagent 工具，并支持前台及可继续的后台子智能体。
summaries.en: Adds a smart_subagent tool that lets each call select a model and reasoning effort while supporting foreground and continuable background child agents.

capabilities: Allows selecting a provider/model per subagent call
Runs foreground and continuable background child agents on the selected model
Preserves the selected model for follow-up messages
